name: Atomstack A20 Pro
tagline: Mid-tier Atomstack with compressed beam : sweet spot between A5 and A40
tldr: The A20 Pro sits in Atomstack's lineup between budget A5 and flagship A40. Strong engraving detail with a more rigid frame than entry models. A sensible upgrade path if A5 feels slow but A40 is over budget.
mainObjective: Mid-range Atomstack for detailed engraving & reliable thin-wood cutting

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Everyday engrave and light cut mix : typical 6 mm basswood in several passes
Open-frame : plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
Atomstack A20 Pro: profile includes material limits, benchmarks, and practical notes on Maker Atlas
Atomstack Atomstack A20 Pro : compare benchmarks and material limits on this profile before ordering.
cons: Verify the 20W SKU : same chassis, different modules
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 20W SKU on Atomstack A20 Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Atomstack's F60 air assist kit is worth adding before pushing cut depth : charring drops significantly on 5–6 mm basswood.
primaryUse: Mid-tier open-frame Atomstack for detailed engraving and moderate thin-wood cutting.

editorialDepth.advantages: Atomstack A20 Pro 20W is the versatile hobby / side-business SKU : clean engraving and light wood or leather cuts with comparable benchmarks on Maker Atlas.
editorialDepth.limitations: Open-frame : glasses and exhaust required. Not a CO₂ replacement for clear acrylic or heavy thick-stock production.
